description: Defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrCollections which manages attribute collections, including loading extensions, performing inclusions, and expanding identifiers within the context of HTMLPurifier.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrCollections
classes.description: Manages attribute collections, including loading extensions, performing inclusions, and expanding identifiers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes attribute collections by loading extensions from modules and performing internal expansions and inclusions.

methods.name: performInclusions
methods.description: Performs all inclusions specified by the zero index in an attribute array, merging included collections.

methods.name: expandIdentifiers
methods.description: Replaces string identifiers in attribute arrays with actual attribute objects from HTMLPurifier_AttrTypes.
